features.redirect_count: Number of observed HTTP redirect headers, including a final header that was not followed
features.unique_redirect_domains: Distinct initial-document or successfully followed response domains; zero when no response or document was observed
features.domain_transition_count: Number of observed redirect headers pointing to a different registrable domain
features.cross_domain_redirect_ratio: Cross-domain redirect headers divided by all observed redirect headers
features.redirect_loop_detected: A header target revisits a normalized destination
features.http_to_https: At least one observed HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect header
features.https_to_http: At least one observed HTTPS-to-HTTP redirect header
features.shortener_detected: Submitted hostname matches the existing Phase 2 shortener registry
features.js_redirect_detected: Static literal JavaScript navigation pattern, not executed navigation
features.meta_refresh_detected: Static meta-refresh destination, not followed navigation
features.final_domain_changed: Successfully retrieved final document differs in registrable domain
